# The GOAT Initiative

> Independent 501(c)(3) nonprofit (EIN 99-3753614) that gathers intelligence along the U.S.–Mexico border, including the San Diego sector, and delivers it to local, state, and federal law enforcement. Founder and president: Cory Gautereaux. The organization does not arrest, detain, or take custody.

Official site: https://www.thegoatinitiative.org

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.thegoatinitiative.org/): Organization overview
- [Mission](https://www.thegoatinitiative.org/mission): What the organization collects and who receives it
- [Operations](https://www.thegoatinitiative.org/operations): Named field operations
- [Leadership](https://www.thegoatinitiative.org/operatives): Cory Gautereaux, Dan Conchas, Tayler James, Hels Apffel
- [Video briefings](https://www.thegoatinitiative.org/media): YouTube briefings, including the organization's own interview
- [Articles](https://www.thegoatinitiative.org/articles): Titles and links for briefings on Cory Gautereaux's Substack
- [Intel updates](https://www.thegoatinitiative.org/intel): Field-report notices
- [Donate](https://www.thegoatinitiative.org/donate): Tax-deductible gifts via Donorbox
- [Contact](https://www.thegoatinitiative.org/contact): Questions and tips. Call 911 first if a crime is in progress
